design_summary: TUMU's playable class roster and their per-class kits — base stats, basic/special/charge/dash attacks, and Circle abilities. New classes (Demolitionist, Healer, Tank, Ninja, Balloonist, Guitarist, Werewolf) were authored alongside an ability-expansion pass that gave every existing class a new Circle ability and aimable weapons. Most class work landed in the v0.9.x baseline (Mar 2026) before release tagging began.

standalone_designs.title: Ranger Swing-Slide-Jump Traversal
standalone_designs.summary: While swinging on a grappling rope and approaching terrain, the Ranger can press JUMP to convert swing momentum into a surface slide, then release JUMP to launch off. Velocity is decomposed into surface-parallel (slide) and normal (launch boost) components, with terrain-following and gravity-on-slope behavior.

standalone_designs.title: Ranger Slide Charge via RampModifierProvider
standalone_designs.summary: Extends the static modifier stack with a RampModifierProvider that lerps modifier values over time, used to ramp the slide-charge boost from 1.0x to 1.5x over 2s. Includes the slide config keys, charge/release lifecycle, and a full set of phase visuals plus a player/slide debug aspect.
